integrity: Self-contained analytic derivation with uniform Fourier-approximation lemma, exact displacement identity, no-wrapping argument and elementary area integration. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The constant is metric- and measure-specific. The theorem requires irrational base angle, nonzero integer winding, C1 periodic shear and a fixed sufficiently small Bowen radius; no uniform Diophantine convergence rate or rational-base extension is claimed.
title: Universal Bowen-ball volume law for irrational skew Dehn twists
